about.title: About WordSprint
about.intro: WordSprint is a lightweight multilingual word game project focused on quick daily play across devices.
about.contactBody: If you want to share feedback, report a bug, or talk about the project, you can reach the creator here.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: WordSprint uses minimal, anonymous server-side analytics to understand which routes are used and what device types are visiting.
privacy.point1: We do not store raw IP addresses.
privacy.point2: We do not use cookies for analytics.
privacy.point3: We do not build advertising profiles or fingerprints.
privacy.point4: We only keep route, language, status code, device type, browser family, and referrer domain.
privacy.point5: The analytics summary is aggregated and intended for lightweight product insight only.
privacy.point6: If you choose to share a display name, it can appear in the private analytics dashboard for the site owner.
